messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a handshake step in routing to enforce subscription-level rate caps and SLO headroom checks before sending to high-cost variants. Thoughts?
kevin: Love the idea. We should evaluate headroom against tier SLOs (p95 target) and only do handshake when headroom > X ms. That avoids unnecessary fallbacks.
tara: Concern: extra RTT on handshake adds latency. Can we piggyback on existing auth/token validation call to avoid another round-trip? @kevin
sam: If we add another sync handshake it's gonna hurt p95. Maybe make it async (accept + stream) but that complicates client SDKs.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: slo-routing-experiments -> staging at 2147991250
maria: Proposed flow (simple): 1) quota/ratecap check 2) SLO headroom estimate 3) pick variant (base / quantized / replica) 4) circuit-breaker check 5) route or fallback. Example policy snippet: ```
policy: {
  tier: 'pro',
  slo_ms: 120,
  cb_threshold: 0.85,
  ratecap: 1000/min
}
```
kevin: We need telemetry hooks for this: per-route token cost, queue depth, cb_tripped_count, fallback_reason. Console should show recent fallback events and headroom over time.
tara: UX note: for rollouts we should support a "soft fallback" mode — route to fallback but surface fallback_rate and quality delta to the customer; useful for canaries.
sam: @maria how exactly do you compute headroom? moving avg p95 minus observed? need something stable and not noisy.
maria: Headroom = SLO_ms - p50_latency_estimate - safety_ms. Safety delta tuned by tier (enterprise gets +40ms). We'll iterate.
kevin: Add region affinity: prefer same-region variants unless CB tripped. Fallback chain idea: same-variant same-region -> quantized same-region -> replica other-region.
tara: Question on billing/quotas: if we preemptively fallback to cheaper variant, do those tokens count towards customer's quota? I think yes, but maybe at a discounted rate.
maria: Recommend counting tokens as billed but attach billing metadata: fallback=true, fallback_variant=<name>. That lets billing rules apply discounts downstream.
sam: Also add alerting: if fallback_rate > 5% for >5m for a single customer, fire ops + account team pager.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'll prototype the ratecap + cb check in the policy engine and open a PR by EOD.
maria: Thanks — I'll add console mockups for 'fallback lineage' and 'cb state' widgets (last 10 events, tripped history). Sync tomorrow 10am to walk through.
tara: :eyes:
kevin: One more thing — we should expose an internal API for 'simulate_routing(policy, sample_request)' so SEs can preview fallback sequences before enabling. That would be very helpful for support.
maria: Great call. Add to backlog and include a small CLI for offline debugging.
